issues.display_title: Issue #1158: Blue Line Map data layer: project type, saved tour copies, published tour list and Switch GoThru account
issues.main_description_html:
Assigned to: Ibnu Rizqia Ramadan — Developer

From PRD #1156 (R31–R37), with the PM answers on #1157 (3, 4, 8, 18). The API side is released (API-GO#204, API-GO#205, API-GO#206). This task is the app's data layer for Blue Line Map; it adds no screen.

Scope

  • Project type: the project list, Recent, create and save calls know the Blue Line Map type, so Blue Line Map projects and 3D projects are listed apart.
  • Tour copy (answer 3): a tour added to a project is kept as a copy: name, key, thumbnail, panorama count and lines. It is built from GoThru's tour list and links, saved with the project, and read back when the project opens.
  • Re-read (answer 3): a saved copy can be replaced by what GoThru returns now. A tour GoThru no longer returns keeps its copy.
  • Published tours (answer 8): the tours Add Tour offers are the Blue Line tours whose Street View publishing is finished, searched by name or key, latest edited first, 20 per step.
  • Empty tours (answer 18): a tour without panoramas is left out of that list, and a tour with nothing to draw is refused when added, by name.
  • Switch GoThru account (answer 4): replaces the connected account in one step. Refused for an account that signs in to MapThru with GoThru, and for a GoThru account already connected to another MapThru account.

Acceptance criteria

  • A Blue Line Map project can be created, listed and read apart from 3D projects.
  • Tours saved to a project come back the same after reopening.
  • Unreadable saved tours are skipped and never break the page.
  • Switch reports each refusal with its own message.
  • pnpm test, pnpm lint, tsc --noEmit green.

RESULT

Implemented and merged to development (a90f1c7e, PR #1164). pnpm test (319 files, 2908 tests at the top of the stack), pnpm lint, pnpm exec tsc --noEmit and pnpm build pass.

What changed

  • src/lib/blueLine/mapTours.ts (new): the tour copy a project keeps (name, key, thumbnail, panorama count, lines), parseMapTours, addMapTours (no duplicates; a tour with nothing to draw is refused by name), refreshMapTours (a tour GoThru no longer returns keeps its copy), isPublishedTour, parseMapProject.
  • src/actions/blueLine.ts: listPublishedBlueLineToursAction (published tours, 20 per step, up to 5 GoThru pages per step), loadMapToursAction, refreshMapToursAction (tour ids checked, at most 100 tours, 5 at a time), switchGothruAction (PUT /v1/gothru/connection).
  • src/actions/projects.ts: ProjectType; list, recent, bootstrap and create take the type; updateProject takes blueLineTours.
  • src/lib/auth/gothruKeycloak.ts, src/app/(auth)/callback/gothru-callback.tsx: a switch mode for the GoThru sign-in, with the sign-in-only refusal.

Checked: no screen of its own; used by the browser checks of #1159–#1162.

Released to main (6e355c52, PR #1170) on 2026-10-05; Deploy run 37249366617 succeeded and map-thru.com serves the new build (/m/{key} answers).

issues.display_title: Issue #1159: Blue Line Map public page: /m/{key} and /embed/{key} show the project's tours
issues.main_description_html:
Assigned to: Ibnu Rizqia Ramadan — Developer

From PRD #1156 (R23, R24, R47), with the PM answers on #1157 (2, 6, 11, 17). Depends on the Blue Line Map data layer task.

No design yet: built from the PRD copy and the existing screens. The look is provisional until the design lands.

Scope

  • Share link /m/{project_key}: the public page of a published Blue Line Map project. It shows the project name, the tours' lines on the map, zoom, and the Street Map / Satellite Map / 3D Building switch. No panorama dots.
  • Open Tour (answer 2b): clicking a tour's line shows its name with an Open Tour link (https://tourmkr.com/F1{tour_key}, new tab).
  • View (answer 6): the map opens fitted to the tours, or at the project location when there are none.
  • Embed /embed/{project_key}: shows the same map for a Blue Line Map project, and stays the 3D viewer for a 3D project.
  • Access (answer 11): as on the 3D share link. A private project shows "This project is private", a secured one asks for its password, a draft or unknown key shows "This project is not available".
  • Colour (answer 17): every tour is drawn in the Blue Line blue, and the picked tour is highlighted.

Dependency

  • Satellite Map tiles are failing on production today (the tile requests answer 400 and 500). The switch is built here, but Satellite Map only passes QA once that is fixed.

Acceptance criteria

  • /m/{key} of a published Blue Line Map project shows its tours' lines without panorama dots.
  • Clicking a line shows the tour name and Open Tour.
  • /embed/{key} shows the Blue Line map for a Blue Line Map project and the 3D viewer for a 3D project.
  • Private, secured and unpublished projects behave as on the 3D share link.
  • pnpm test, pnpm lint, tsc --noEmit green.

RESULT

Implemented and merged to development (8a4269c5, PR #1165). pnpm test (319 files, 2908 tests at the top of the stack), pnpm lint, pnpm exec tsc --noEmit and pnpm build pass.

What changed

  • src/components/blue-line/map/TourLinesMap.tsx, MapDisplaySwitch.tsx, BlueLineMapViewer.tsx (new): the tours as lines only, the selection highlighted, Street Map / Satellite Map / 3D Building, and the card of the clicked tour with Open Tour.
  • src/app/v/[key]/page.tsx: the viewer is picked by project type, so /v, /m and /embed open the right one. src/app/m/[key]/page.tsx and layout.tsx (new). src/lib/preview/shareMetadata.ts (new) serves the tab title and link card of both /v and /m.
  • src/lib/analytics/countly.ts: /m/[key] among the view names.

Checked in the browser (GPU Chrome, an in-memory stand-in for the API): 23 of 23 checks, including the line click, Open Tour, the display switch, private, secured and unpublished projects, and /embed/{key}.

Not verified: Satellite Map on production, whose tile source does not load.

issues.display_title: Issue #1160: Blue Line Map editor: Project Information, tour list, selection, Save, Publish, Share and Clone
issues.main_description_html:
Assigned to: Ibnu Rizqia Ramadan — Developer

From PRD #1156 (R11–R13, R21–R28, R38–R50), with the PM answers on #1157 (3, 6, 7, 9, 10, 12–17). Depends on the Blue Line Map data layer and public page tasks.

No design yet: built from the PRD copy and today's Blue Line editor. The look is provisional until the design lands.

Scope

  • New Project form (R11–R13): Project Name, Address or Label, Latitude, Longitude and the map viewer, as in Create an Empty Project. Create Project makes a Blue Line Map project and opens its editor. No GoThru connection is needed.
  • Project Information sidebar (R25–R28):
    • Project Name, Address Name, Latitude and Longitude.
    • Search tours. The Add Tour button comes with the Add Tour task.
    • The tour list with the total, and each tour's thumbnail, name, key and panorama count.
  • Map (R38, R39, answers 6, 17): tour lines without panorama dots, all in the Blue Line blue, with Street Map / Satellite Map / 3D Building. It opens fitted to the tours, or at the project location when there are none. No placement tools.
  • Selection (R40–R42, answer 10): click a tour on the map or in the list; Shift selects more. The selection section shows the selected count, Delete and Clear Selection. Delete asks once: "Remove {n} tours from this project? They stay in your GoThru account."
  • Save (R43, answer 9): icon-only Save. "Changes aren't saved" shows until saved, a saved project is confirmed, and leaving with unsaved changes asks first.
  • Re-read on open (answer 3): opening the project reads its tours again from the connected GoThru account. Tours that changed show as unsaved until Save; tours that can't be read keep their copy.
  • Project menu (R44, answer 12): a Project button with Dashboard, New Project and Help.
  • Publish, Unpublish, Share (R46–R50, answers 13–15):
    • Blue Publish with the 3D project's confirmation, disabled until the project has a tour.
    • Publishing saves unsaved changes first, so the public map matches what is on screen.
    • Once published: white Unpublish and Share.
  • Share modal (R21–R24): Secured Project, Share Link /m/{project_key} and Embed Map /embed/{project_key}.
  • Clone (R45, answer 16): Clone opens today's Clone modal with every tour of the project selected.

Dependency

  • Satellite Map tiles are failing on production today. The switch is built here, but Satellite Map only passes QA once that is fixed.

Acceptance criteria

  • Create Project opens the editor of a new Blue Line Map project.
  • The sidebar shows the project's information and its tours.
  • Tours can be selected, with Shift for several, and removed after one confirmation.
  • Save stores the tours; reopening the project shows them again.
  • Leaving with unsaved changes asks first.
  • Publish, Unpublish and Share follow the project's state, and the share link is /m/{project_key}.
  • No placement tool is shown.
  • pnpm test, pnpm lint, tsc --noEmit green.

RESULT

Implemented and merged to development (b301ee6a, PR #1166). pnpm test (319 files, 2908 tests at the top of the stack), pnpm lint, pnpm exec tsc --noEmit and pnpm build pass.

What changed

  • src/components/blue-line/map/BlueLineMapEditor.tsx, BlueLineMapNav.tsx, BlueLineMapSidebar.tsx, BlueLineMapNewProject.tsx (new).
  • src/app/dashboard/blueline/[id]/page.tsx: opens a Blue Line Map project; a 3D project's id goes to the floor plan editor.
  • src/components/preview/PreviewShareModal.tsx (blueLineMap: /m/{key}, no virtual tour link), src/lib/preview/publish.ts (blueLineMapUrl), BlueLineCloneModal.tsx (named after the project).
  • Fix cab02c3f: Shift+click on a line on the map adds to the selection. MapLibre's box zoom swallowed that click; the map turns box zoom off. Found while filming the demo.

Checked in the browser (GPU Chrome, an in-memory stand-in for the API): 41 of 41 checks, and the whole flow filmed after the fix.

Known limits: the browser's Back button inside the app is not caught by the leave guard, and the floor plan editor does not refuse a Blue Line Map id typed into /editor/{id}.

Not verified: saving to the real API.

Released to main (6e355c52, PR #1170) on 2026-10-05; Deploy run 37249366617 succeeded and map-thru.com serves the new build (/m/{key} answers).

issues.display_title: Issue #1161: Blue Line Map Add Tour: connect or switch GoThru, sync and add published tours
issues.main_description_html:
Assigned to: Ibnu Rizqia Ramadan — Developer

From PRD #1156 (R6, R29–R37), with the PM answers on #1157 (4, 8, 9, 18). Depends on the Blue Line Map editor task.

No design yet: built from the PRD copy and the existing screens. The look is provisional until the design lands.

Scope

  • The editor's sidebar gets an Add Tour button, which opens a modal.
  • Not connected (R29): it explains that a GoThru account is needed to add Blue Line tours and offers Connect GoThru. After the GoThru sign-in, the user is back in Add Tour.
  • Connected (R30–R33):
    • The connected GoThru account's email.
    • Switch GoThru Account (answer 4): opens the GoThru sign-in screen and replaces the connection in one step. An account that signs in to MapThru with GoThru cannot switch, and is told so.
    • Sync Tours reads the list again.
    • The published Blue Line tours, each with its thumbnail, name, key and panorama count.
  • The list (answer 8): search by tour name or key, latest edited first, 20 tours per scroll step. Tours already in the project stay listed, ticked and disabled, with an "Added" label.
  • Selecting (R34, R35): several tours can be ticked. Add Tours adds everything selected in one step, and each tour lands at its own location (R37).
  • Empty tours (answer 18): a tour with nothing to draw is refused with a message that names it; the other selected tours are added. Tours GoThru reports without panoramas are not listed.
  • No tours: a connected account without published Blue Line tours gets a message offering to sync again or to create a Blue Line tour in the GoThru Dashboard.
  • Saving (answer 9): Connect GoThru and Switch GoThru Account leave for the GoThru sign-in screen, so unsaved changes are saved first.
  • Disconnect GoThru stays available here, since the Blue Line page that had it becomes the project dashboard (#1151 answer 4).

Acceptance criteria

  • Add Tour shows the connection guidance when no GoThru account is connected, and returns to Add Tour after connecting.
  • The connected account is shown, and Switch replaces it.
  • Sync Tours refreshes the list.
  • Several tours can be selected and added at once; added tours appear on the map and in the tour list.
  • A tour already in the project cannot be added twice.
  • A tour with nothing to draw is refused by name.
  • pnpm test, pnpm lint, tsc --noEmit green.

RESULT

Implemented and merged to development (b81feeb4, PR #1167). pnpm test (319 files, 2908 tests at the top of the stack), pnpm lint, pnpm exec tsc --noEmit and pnpm build pass.

What changed

  • src/components/blue-line/map/AddTourModal.tsx (new): without a connection, Connect GoThru; connected, the account, Switch GoThru Account, Sync Tours, Disconnect GoThru, and the published tours searched by name or key, 20 per step, with tours already added shown as Added.
  • BlueLineMapSidebar.tsx: the Add Tour button. BlueLineMapEditor.tsx: adds the tours in one step and brings them into view; unsaved changes are saved before leaving for the GoThru sign-in, and coming back opens Add Tour again.

Checked in the browser (GPU Chrome, an in-memory stand-in for the API): 30 of 30 checks. The GoThru sign-in request was stopped and inspected, never opened.

Not verified: Connect and Switch through the real GoThru sign-in.

Released to main (6e355c52, PR #1170) on 2026-10-05; Deploy run 37249366617 succeeded and map-thru.com serves the new build (/m/{key} answers).

issues.display_title: Issue #1162: Blue Line Map dashboard: projects, New Project, counters, filters and project actions
issues.main_description_html:
Assigned to: Ibnu Rizqia Ramadan — Developer

From PRD #1156 (R1–R24), with the PM answers on #1157 (7, 11, 13–15). Depends on the Blue Line Map editor task.

No design yet: built from the PRD copy and the Workspace dashboard. The look is provisional until the design lands.

Scope

  • Name (R1, R2): the Blue Line menu and page title become Blue Line Map.
  • Projects, not tours (R3–R8): the page lists Blue Line Map projects and opens without a GoThru connection. Removed from it: View All Blue Line Tours on One Map, Sync Tours, the Connect to GoThru Dashboard layout and the No Blue Line Tours Available Yet layout.
  • New Project (R11–R13): opens the New Project form; the new project opens in the editor.

issues.display_title: Issue #1163: Remove the old Blue Line tour pages and placement editors
issues.main_description_html:
Assigned to: Ibnu Rizqia Ramadan — Developer

From PRD #1156 (R3, R4, R7, R8, non-goals 3 and 4), with PM answer 1 on #1157: today's Blue Line tour pages and editors are removed, and panoramas can no longer be moved in MapThru. Last task of the set: it runs once the Blue Line Map dashboard and editor are in place.

Scope

  • Remove the Blue Line tour list, its tour cards and the per-tour Share modal.
  • Remove the single-tour editor and the multiple-tour editor, with their placement tools: move, rotate, scale, snap alignment, reset, undo and redo, and Save to GoThru.
  • Remove Edit Multiple Tours and the View All Blue Line Tours on One Map offer.
  • Old tour editor links (/dashboard/blueline/{tour id}, /dashboard/blueline/multi) go to the Blue Line Map dashboard.
  • Kept, because Blue Line Map uses them: Clone, the GoThru connection, and reading a tour's panoramas for Clone.

Out of scope

  • The API endpoint that saves panorama positions to GoThru stays until the API team removes it.

Acceptance criteria

  • No page or control moves a panorama.
  • Old tour editor links open the Blue Line Map dashboard.
  • Clone still creates a 3D project from a Blue Line Map project's tours.
  • pnpm test, pnpm lint, tsc --noEmit green.

RESULT

Implemented and merged to development (cb753cc0, PR #1169). pnpm test (319 files, 2908 tests at the top of the stack), pnpm lint, pnpm exec tsc --noEmit and pnpm build pass.

What changed

  • Removed: the tour list (BlueLineDashboardView, BlueLineTourCard, BlueLineShareModal, BlueLineStates, BlueLineOneMapOffer), the single and multiple tour editors (BlueLineEditorView, BlueLineMultiEditorView, BlueLineMultiLoader, components/blue-line/editor/), their helpers (geojson, multiEdit, multiTour, groupPlacement), the actions only they used (a page of tours, saving panorama positions), and /dashboard/blueline/multi.
  • src/app/dashboard/blueline/[id]/page.tsx (was [mid]): anything that is not a project id goes to the Blue Line Map dashboard.
  • getBlueLineTourAction, kept for Clone, refuses anything that is not a real tour id.

Checked in the browser (the demo take, real Chrome): an old tour editor link lands on the dashboard, the editor opens at its new address, and Clone opens. Mutation checks: 20 of 20 caught.

Not verified in a browser: /dashboard/blueline/multi (unit test only), and Clone creating a 3D project after the removal.

issues.display_title: Issue #1171: Public API: a published Blue Line Map's tour lines as GeoJSON for other sites
issues.main_description_html:
Assigned to: Ibnu Rizqia Ramadan — Developer

Follow-up to PRD #1156. maps.gothru.co (gothru-maps-frontend) draws Blue Line Map projects on its embed page, so it needs the tour lines of a published project without a MapThru session.

Scope

  • GET /api/m/{key}/lines on map-thru.com: the tours of a published Blue Line Map as a GeoJSON FeatureCollection, one MultiLineString per tour with mid, tourKey, name and panoramaCount, and a top-level bbox when there are lines.
  • Access: the same gates as the share link /m/{key}, since it reads /v1/live/:key without credentials: a draft or unknown key is 404, a private project 403, a secured one 401. A 3D project's key is 404.
  • Other sites: Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *, Content-Type: application/geo+json, cached for 60 s.

No change on the Go API: it reads the existing /v1/live/:key.

Acceptance criteria

  • A published Blue Line Map's key returns its tours as GeoJSON with a bbox.
  • Draft, private, secured and unknown keys keep the share link's answers, and a 3D project's key is 404.
  • A browser on another site can read it (CORS).
  • pnpm test, pnpm lint, tsc --noEmit green.

RESULT

Implemented and merged to development (01663812, PR #1172). pnpm test (320 files, 2915 tests), pnpm lint, pnpm exec tsc --noEmit and pnpm build pass.

What changed

  • src/app/api/m/[key]/lines/route.ts (new): GET /api/m/{key}/lines reads /v1/live/:key without credentials and answers the tours as a GeoJSON FeatureCollection, one MultiLineString per tour with mid, tourKey, name and panoramaCount, plus bbox. Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *, application/geo+json, cached 60 s. 401, 403 and 404 from the share link's read pass through, a 3D project's key is 404, an unreachable API 502.
  • src/lib/blueLine/mapTours.ts: tourFeatures carries tourKey, name and panoramaCount besides mid.

Tests: src/app/api/m/[key]/lines/__tests__/route.test.ts (7). Four mutants each turn a test red.

Released to main (a2066dc8, PR #1173) on 2026-10-05; Deploy run 37289102405 succeeded. On production, https://map-thru.com/api/m/fPMEbGwq/lines answers 200 with Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * and the 2 tours of the published "Subang" map plus a box; an unknown key answers 404.
